data.task_title: Create Artemis self-demo with Chart.js visualization

features.title: Implement Chart.js Visualizations
features.description: Utilize Chart.js to create various data visualizations for the Artemis demo.
acceptance_criteria: Pipeline metrics are visualized using Chart.js.
Cost tracking and success rates are displayed with charts.
Charts are interactive and include animations.

features.title: Showcase Artemis Features
features.description: Highlight key features of Artemis including pipeline stages, cost tracking, and integration.
acceptance_criteria: Include a section explaining Artemis as an Autonomous AI Development System.
Visualize the 8-stage pipeline using Chart.js.
Display features like cost tracking and sandboxing with metrics.

features.title: Display Live Metrics with Real-Time Dashboard
features.description: Create a real-time dashboard using Chart.js to show live metrics such as LLM cost and success rates.
acceptance_criteria: LLM cost over time is shown with a line chart.
Stage completion rates are displayed with a bar chart.
Success rate trends are visualized with an area chart.

features.title: Present Real Metrics from Recent Runs
features.description: Include real metrics from recent Artemis runs to demonstrate system effectiveness.
acceptance_criteria: Metrics are sourced from recent Artemis runs.
Data is presented accurately and clearly.
Metrics support the value and effectiveness of Artemis.

features.title: Create Standalone HTML Presentation
features.description: Develop a single HTML file with embedded CSS, JavaScript, and Chart.js for the Artemis demo.
acceptance_criteria: HTML file is standalone with no external dependencies.
CSS and JavaScript are embedded within the HTML.
Chart.js is included for data visualization.

features.title: Integrate Supervisor Across Stages
features.description: Demonstrate supervisor integration across different stages using a pie chart.
acceptance_criteria: A pie chart shows supervisor integration across stages.
Data is accurate and reflects actual integration points.
Chart is interactive and visually clear.

features.title: Auto-Advance Slides with Navigation Controls
features.description: Implement functionality for slides to auto-advance with user navigation controls.
acceptance_criteria: Slides auto-advance after a set duration.
Users can manually navigate slides using controls.
Navigation controls are intuitive and responsive.

features.title: Highlight Code Quality Metrics
features.description: Use a radar chart to showcase code quality metrics such as TDD compliance and adherence to SOLID principles.
acceptance_criteria: Radar chart displays TDD compliance and SOLID principles.
Metrics are based on real data from recent runs.
Chart is clear and easy to interpret.

features.title: Design Professional Presentation
features.description: Ensure the presentation has a professional appearance with gradient backgrounds and smooth transitions.
acceptance_criteria: Gradient backgrounds are used throughout the presentation.
Slide transitions are smooth and professional.
Overall design is visually impressive.
